subject_definitions:

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a single shot built from <Picture 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] storyboard reference): partially_preserved - the viewpoint, subject placement and framing are followed, while the shot develops in time away from that exact arrangement.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same two people throughout, the woman in a grey-blue apron and the young man in a pale-blue shirt seen from behind. The camera holds a static shot. Her right arm is already reached back behind her with her hand flat on the door; she pushes it the last few centimetres until it seats shut and the thin cool-white strip of corridor light in the gap is cut off; the young man in the near foreground releases the suitcase handle and his hand drops to his side. a door clicking softly shut, then insects outside the window. [Shot 2] At 00:03.042, the camera cuts to the framing holds a close-up on her face. The camera stands in front of the guest-room window at eye level, about 1.5 metres up, looking back toward the door. The camera holds a static shot. Her right hand, still raised in front of her from the gesture she has just finished, comes down and meets the other in front of the apron, and the two keep rubbing against each other; her upper body angles a few degrees toward the door behind her. The speaker (S1) says, dropping her volume to almost a breath, <d>[Chinese] 小砚，在人家里住着，多一事不如少一事，</d> cloth rubbing, insects outside. Her right hand lifts and presses once on his forearm, then lowers back to her lap; her eyes stay on his face waiting. The speaker (S1) says, still almost whispering, the last syllable pleading, <d>[Chinese] 别跟她们顶嘴，啊？</d>

overall_soundscape:
A door clicking softly shut, then insects outside the window. Cloth rubbing, insects outside.
